subject.title: Feature request: auto-update for skills and plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add opt-in background auto-updates for ClawHub skills and installed plugins, and what trust, pinning, install-policy, rollback, audit, and failure contract must gate it?
rationale: The request changes unattended third-party code download/application plus public config and startup behavior, so cleanup automation cannot safely choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Design gated opt-in updater
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define the security and lifecycle contract, including install-policy handling and rollback or audit expectations.

options.title: Keep explicit manual updates
options.body: Keep `openclaw skills update` and `openclaw plugins update` as the supported path and document cron or operator automation as a power-user workflow.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics first
options.body: Track plugin/skill version drift and update prompts before allowing automatic apply, preserving operator review while reducing friction.

recommendation.title: Design gated opt-in updater
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define the security and lifecycle contract, including install-policy handling and rollback or audit expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest recent history across updater behavior, plugin lifecycle framing, and source-grounded security/docs surfaces.
